data.title: The lamp and the corner
data.goal: Describe an awkward movement and explain how to move the furniture without damaging it.

data.situation: The next afternoon, Jo stood at the door while Lin closed the notebook on the desk. They wanted to move the little table nearer the window so the lamp would reach her reading chair. The table belonged to the landlord; the lamp was borrowed from Jo. Lin was careful with it. She carried it to the windowsill first and placed it well away from the edge. Lin lifted one end of the table and tried to turn it towards the window by herself. In one clumsy movement, she caught a pile of books with the table leg. Two books slid onto the floor. She stopped at once. “Sorry. Let us clear the space first,” she said. Jo picked up the books and put them on the shelf. Nothing had broken, but the narrow turn needed more room. They moved the chair out of the way, then took an end each. Jo watched the wall as Lin guided the legs past the corner. They were careful not to scrape the paint. Once the table was beside the window, Lin brought the lamp back. Its light fell across the open book, instead of stopping at the door. She could sit back in the chair without leaning towards the page. Before Jo left, they walked from the desk to the door. The passage was clear. Lin put the fallen books back with the others and laughed at her earlier attempt. “Next time, I will ask for another pair of hands before I lift it.” Jo sat down for a moment while Lin made tea. The lamp shone over the table, and no one had to squeeze past it to leave.
data.easySummary: Lin moves the borrowed lamp first. A clumsy turn knocks two books onto the floor. She and Jo clear the space and lift the table together. They are careful not to scrape the wall. The lamp reaches the chair, and the way to the door stays clear.
data.easySummaryZh: 林先搬开借来的台灯。一次不灵巧的转身让两本书掉到地上。她和乔腾出空间，一起抬桌子，小心地避免刮掉墙漆。台灯照到椅子，门边通道也保持畅通。

retrievalPrompts.cue: The lamp belongs to Jo. Before moving the table, Lin puts it away from the edge of the windowsill. Explain how she treats it.

acceptableAnswers: Lin is careful with the borrowed lamp. She puts it away from the edge before moving the table.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Say what she protects and what she does.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 说出保护的物品和具体动作。

retrievalPrompts.cue: Lin turns the table alone, and its leg catches a pile of books. Describe the movement and what happens next.

acceptableAnswers: One clumsy movement knocks two books onto the floor. Lin stops. She and Jo clear the space before moving the table again.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Describe this attempt rather than judging the whole person.

transferPrompt.cue: You carry a tray of cups towards a narrow doorway. An awkward turn makes one cup slide, but your friend catches it. Explain the movement, then tell your friend how you will carry the tray together.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 你端着一托盘杯子走向窄门。一次转身不稳让一个杯子滑动，朋友接住了它。说明这个动作，再告诉朋友接下来怎样一起端托盘。
acceptableAnswers: A clumsy turn made a cup slide. We should be careful not to let the cups fall while we carry the tray together.
transferPrompt.feedback: The cup was caught; do not invent a broken cup.
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: 杯子被接住了，不要说它已经摔碎。
checks: 提出careful not to避免掉落的后续动作
